original_request: Create an English, paper-ready time-series chart from verified Problem 3 monthly savings. Show monthly and cumulative realized savings of the selected raw-PV rolling policy relative to the no-update policy. Use a clean scientific style, muted colours, readable units, no 3D, no pie chart, no smoothing, and no significance stars.
goal: Show how the realized saving of the selected Problem 3 update policy accumulates over months.
